messages.text: Map the chain from a AI market requirement to a measurable parameter and then to a required capability of Oscilloscope.

Short answer: AI training/inference demand → AI Cluster high-speed data transmission → eye diagram/interface test → oscilloscope must support high-speed electrical interface testing; exact oscilloscope bandwidth, data rate, model, and options are not specified in the passages.[42][53][56]
| Chain step | Supported mapping |
|---|---|
| AI market requirement | The AI Server supply chain starts from Demand, described as AI training and inference demand, with high CAPEX growth in AI data-centre investment.[38][42] |
| Technical requirement created by that market demand | The Networking layer is described as AI Cluster high-speed data transmission, using 800G / 1.6T, Ethernet, and InfiniBand technologies.[42] |
| Measurable parameter / validation item | The signal-integrity flow for high-speed PCB/PCBA lists IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, and TDR Impedance; the electrical-interface validation overview also lists Interface Test.[53][56] |
| Required oscilloscope capability | Interface Test explicitly lists Scopes among the instruments, so the oscilloscope role supported by the passages is high-speed electrical interface testing; the passages do not provide oscilloscope bandwidth, sample rate, data-rate support, model, or option codes.[53] |
【推論】For this chain, the practical oscilloscope capability to require is eye-diagram-capable high-speed interface testing, derived from the AI Cluster high-speed transmission requirement and the listed SI/interface-test measurements; however, the knowledge base does not verify any specific oscilloscope specification or option for 800G / 1.6T testing.[42][53][56]

Short answer: AI training/inference demand → AI Cluster high-speed data transmission → eye diagram/interface test → oscilloscope must support high-speed electrical interface testing; exact oscilloscope bandwidth, data rate, model, and options are not specified in the passages.[42][53][56]
| Chain step | Supported mapping |
|---|---|
| AI market requirement | The AI Server supply chain starts from Demand, described as AI training and inference demand, with high CAPEX growth in AI data-centre investment.[38][42] |
| Technical requirement created by that market demand | The Networking layer is described as AI Cluster high-speed data transmission, using 800G / 1.6T, Ethernet, and InfiniBand technologies.[42] |
| Measurable parameter / validation item | The signal-integrity flow for high-speed PCB/PCBA lists IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, and TDR Impedance; the electrical-interface validation overview also lists Interface Test.[53][56] |
| Required oscilloscope capability | Interface Test explicitly lists Scopes among the instruments, so the oscilloscope role supported by the passages is high-speed electrical interface testing; the passages do not provide oscilloscope bandwidth, sample rate, data-rate support, model, or option codes.[53] |
【推論】For this chain, the practical oscilloscope capability to require is eye-diagram-capable high-speed interface testing, derived from the AI Cluster high-speed transmission requirement and the listed SI/interface-test measurements; however, the knowledge base does not verify any specific oscilloscope specification or option for 800G / 1.6T testing.[42][53][56]
